_readme: Resolution-only dev set for scoring N3/N4 in isolation (resolution/screen_graph.py, resolution/binder.py) without needing Dev A's SIIS->steps extraction pipeline, which does not exist yet. Every scenario here is either (a) taken verbatim from an official source (sample_output.json, the brief's Appendix-B worked example) or (b) hand-constructed by the Dev B author against a specific real catalog entry, then verified to actually resolve there. This is NOT the brief's called-for 80-100 scenario, four-domain hand-labelled dev set - that needs real SIIS text run through extraction, which is blocked on Dev A's P0. Scope: Display + a couple of Battery/System entries, screen-resolution correctness only (no step-accuracy or provenance scoring, which are N5/Dev A's territory). Update 2026-09-29: added 16 hand-labelled scenarios (ids prefixed labelled_) across Display, Battery, Performance and Connections, each labelled by reading the catalog entry's message/description BEFORE running the resolver (labels were not adjusted to match its output).
